title: Kantata pricing - No official list price; third-party estimates vary widely
clean_text: Kantata does not publish official list pricing; quotes are based on user count, feature tier, customizations, and integrations. Third-party estimates are inconsistent: one industry estimate suggests roughly $50-$100 per user per month for small teams, scaling to $5,000-$10,000+ per month total for around 100 users, while a separate aggregator listed a $19-$69/month range that appears inconsistent with Kantata's enterprise PSA positioning and may reflect a data error rather than Kantata's actual pricing. Implementation, customization, training, and data migration are billed separately and can range from a few thousand dollars for small firms to tens or hundreds of thousands for enterprise deployments.
